coverage.member: FusionRating(this InputBoundField<TModel, double> setup, Action<RatingBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionRating builder stops rendering the rating bound to the model value (the test asserts the survey opens showing 3 of 5 stars carried over from last month)
the ValueChanged event arg contract stops delivering the change payload into the plan, so rating a star shows neither the new score nor its message
Value stops carrying the newly selected rating (the test asserts the response reads 5 of 5 stars and the high-score message after clicking the fifth star)
the ValueChanged event stops firing the reactive handler when the resident clicks a star, so the visible response never updates
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the rating's value-changed event to its plan pipeline, so clicking a star runs no reaction
PreviousValue stops carrying the value before the change (the test lowers the carried-over 3 to 2 and asserts the change note reads the prior 3)
IsInteracted stops distinguishing a rating the resident chose (true -> ready to submit) from a programmatic clear (false -> please rate); the test asserts both readiness messages in sequence
Reset stops clearing the rating to 0 (the test asserts the visible rating and the score text both become 0 after Clear)

coverage.member: SetValue(this ComponentRef<FusionRating, TModel> self, double value)
coverage.catches: SetValue stops writing the given value onto the rating (the test rates 5, restores, and asserts the rating returns to 3)
the Value source stops yielding the current rating into the gather body (the test asserts the POST carries "satisfactionScore":5)

acceptedFanout.reason: one user gesture (clicking the fifth star) with DISTINCT fails-when-broken assertions per member: the visible rating becoming 5 (FusionRatingValueChangedArgs.Value), the response message appearing (ValueChanged firing the handler / Reactive wiring connecting it), and the payload being delivered at all (FusionRatingValueChangedArgs). Each member has its own assertion in this test, not one assertion claimed for many members.
